name: edunova-lms
description: EduNova LMS - Full-stack workspace (Express API + React web client)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix lms-backend" "npm run dev --prefix lms-frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c green,magenta "npm start --prefix lms-backend" "npm run dev --prefix lms-frontend"
scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix lms-backend && npm install --prefix lms-frontend

author: Team EduNova
